info.title: VTSA CSMS Platform API
info.description: Versioned platform API including identity, tenancy, public station discovery, and asset administration.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Public liveness and readiness probes for infrastructure automation.

tags.name: Identity
tags.description: First-party mobile authentication, verification, invitations, and devices.

tags.name: Sites
tags.description: Tenant- and assignment-scoped site directory and reporting foundation.

tags.name: Public Stations
tags.description: Public-safe discovery backed by PostGIS proximity and bounds queries.

tags.name: App Configuration
tags.description: Public, cacheable, non-secret client rendering recommendations.

tags.name: Assets
tags.description: Tenant- and site-scoped charging-station administration and data transfer.

tags.name: Charging
tags.description: Tenant- and site-scoped charging sessions, command orchestration, review, and CDR evidence.

tags.name: Tariffs
tags.description: Versioned tariff definitions and immutable published pricing rules.

tags.name: Procurement
tags.description: Tenant-scoped requisition, sourcing, purchase-order, vendor-invoice, and three-way-match workflows.

tags.name: Inventory
tags.description: Warehouse-scoped stock custody, immutable movements, reservations, transfers, counts, and work-order parts.

tags.name: Maintenance
tags.description: Tenant- and site-scoped incidents, work orders, evidence, technician activity, and maintenance reporting.

tags.name: Payment Webhooks
tags.description: Signature-verified provider callbacks with tenant-bound destination identifiers and replay protection.
